queue.hypothesis: Increase conv_kernel from 4 to 8 to expand the receptive field for capturing longer-range local dependencies in associative retrieval
queue.rationale: The conv_kernel parameter controls the convolution kernel size in GatedDeltaNet, determining how far back the model can attend to local patterns. Increasing it from 4 to 8 allows the model to capture longer-range dependencies within the convolutional pathway, complementing the recurrent memory mechanism for the N=16 task.
queue.instruction: Change the conv_kernel value from 4 to 8 in the experiment_config.yaml file under the RMM-specific parameters section.
